text:
ci-bot: Alert: eval-smoke pipeline failed for redwood/s-3b-q8 (canary). metric 'answer_f1' -7.1% vs baseline. dashboard: https://dash.redwood.local/evals/summary/5789 :rotating_light:
Maria Chen: saw this too. failing only on q8 quantized variant, host us-east-1-canary
Devin Patel: re-ran locally, reproduced. quick log: `eval-runner --suite smoke --model redwood/s-3b-q8 --seed 42` -> 29.4 -> baseline 36.5
Kelsey Ortiz: is this the same slowdown as last week? or tokenization mismatch?
Devin Patel: looks like tokenizer differences. some prompts get split differently. I diffed token counts for samples that dropped dramatically
Samir Rao: any recent tokenizer releases? I think tokenizer-service bumped to 0.12.1 in last deploy
Maria Chen: yes, tokenizer-service 0.12.1 rolled yesterday at 00:12 UTC. changelog mentioned improved byte-pair rules for unicode.
Kelsey Ortiz: can we pin old tokenizer and re-run smoke to confirm? we need to decide on release hold ASAP
Devin Patel: trying a quick bisect to confirm commit: `git checkout main && git bisect start --eval-script ./scripts/run-smoke.sh`
Devin Patel: quick note: the regression only appears when `--batching=continuous` is enabled (our canary uses continuous). with single-request batching f1 matches baseline
Maria Chen: that suggests interaction between tokenization and batching/KV cache; weird
eval-runner-bot: rerun queued: `eval-runner --suite smoke --model redwood/s-3b-q8 --tokenizer pinned@0.12.0 --batching=continuous` (job 8392)
Samir Rao: results from pinned tokenizer: answer_f1 +5.9% vs failing run, now within tolerance. canary still blocked until we fix upstream tokenizer
Kelsey Ortiz: proposal: rollback tokenizer-service to 0.12.0 in canary region and pin eval CI to 0.12.0 until we have a compatibility test.
Maria Chen: agreed. also create an integration test that runs a small sample with continuous batching + quantized kernels on PRs to tokenizer-service
Devin Patel: opened RFC/PR: https://git.redwood/s/tokenizer-service/pulls/214 "compat test for continuous batching"
Kelsey Ortiz: ops, we should also add a check in our eval CI gating: if quantized run + continuous batching deviates >3% fail the job and notify #eng-ml
Samir Rao: created infra ticket INF-762 to pin canary and schedule rollback. rolling back now in us-east-1-canary (started 1804801255)
Maria Chen: after rollback, re-run smoke: `eval-runner --suite smoke --model redwood/s-3b-q8 --batching=continuous` -> answer_f1 back to baseline.
Kelsey Ortiz: unblocking release, hold removed. create follow-up to triage tokenizer change root cause (token split differences on certain unicode emoji sequences).
Devin Patel: adding unit tests for those emoji cases into tokenizer repo, and adding a short eval smoke into our pre-merge CI for quantized models.
Maria Chen: thanks all. summary for postmortem: regression caused by tokenizer 0.12.1 BPE rule change interacting with continuous batching + quantized kernels. mitigations: rollback, pin tokenizer in eval CI, add compatibility tests, and add metric guard in release gating. cc: @platform-ops for watch
Kelsey Ortiz: :thumbsup: filing follow-ups: TICKET-3482 (compat tests), TICKET-3483 (gating rule), TICKET-3484 (tokenizer fix). closing thread."
